g.text: Meera confirmed a 2-night Coorg trip for 6 on 3–5 Oct.
Quoted ₹42,000; she accepted and will pay the advance
today. Asked for a vegetarian menu.
Next: send payment link and confirm menu by 6 pm
Hi Meera, this is Krisha from Ratha. Is now a good time?
Yes! We were planning Coorg on the 3rd for six of us.
Lovely. For six, one caravan works. It's ₹42,000 for two nights.
